description: VESYEY crystallizes in the triclinic crystal system with space group P -1. Reported CIF formula moiety: 8(C6 H8 N1 1+),H12 Cl8 La2 O6 2-,H24 Cl14 La4 O12 2-,4(Cl1 1-),6(H2 O1),C6 H7 N1. From the CIF bond table, La1 (La) has 3 O neighbors; La1A (La) has 3 O neighbors; La2 (La) has 4 O neighbors; La3 (La) has 2 O neighbors; La2A (La) has 4 O neighbors; La3A (La) has 2 O neighbors. Oxygen-bridged metal connectivity is not established from the available bond table. Article card reports molecular formula (mpyH)8[{(H2O)3Cl3La(μ-Cl)2}2][{(H2O)4Cl2La(μ-Cl)2La(OH2)2Cl2(μ-Cl)2}2]Cl4·6H2O·mpy. Explicit grouped units in the article formula/name: 3 H2O (explicit grouped unit in article formula), 4 H2O (explicit grouped unit in article formula). Article name explicitly identifies I(II).
interpretation_limit: Oxidation states, nuclearity, oxo/hydroxo bridging, core charge and ligand identities/counts require article/SI or manual verification; atom-site counts are asymmetric-unit counts, not molecular stoichiometry. Graph topology is limited to identity-symmetry bonds in the CIF table. Approximate shape is based only on bridge-unwrapped metal-site coordinates in the largest component; symmetry-related bonds or periodic structures require manual crystallographic review. Empirical formulas alone do not establish unique oxidation-state assignments or ligand connectivity; annotations above reproduce explicit structural notation only.
